changelog: - **A date range that ends "today" now includes today** (#1501, #1484). Every screen with a range picker sends `to` as `YYYY-MM-DD` — what an `<input type="date"` holds, and what `toISOString().slice(0, 10)` produces — and `new Date('2026-09-23')` is that day's **first** instant. Used as an `lte` bound it excluded everything that happened *during* the day the admin picked, so on the analytics screen's default "6m" preset the trends chart, the interaction and meeting counts and the RSVP rate all silently omitted the current day. It read as a rendering bug rather than a data one: with a database whose rows were all created today — a CI shard's — the trends chart was twelve bars of zero, which is how it came back after #1425 had already fixed the layout underneath it and closed that exact symptom. The rule is now one dependency-free, unit-tested module (`src/lib/dateRange.ts`): a date-only bound names a **day**, so `from` is its first instant and `to` its last (`23:59:59.999`, inclusive, because two of the callers compare in JS with `<=` and an exclusive bound would be a trap); a bound that carries a time is taken literally. Local rather than UTC, because the month bucketing these ranges fill is local, and a range that disagreed with its own buckets would be a subtler version of the same bug. All six call sites read it: admin analytics, the funnel, the aging report, mentor analytics, the calendar window and the invitations board — the last of which had found the bug independently and fixed it inline, which is precisely why the other five still had it. Pinned by `scripts/test/date-range.test.mjs` and by an e2e regression that compares the bounded call against the unbounded one rather than asserting "> 0": a threshold passes on any database with history in it, which is how this shipped twice.

en: Analytics ranges now include the day they end on. Picking a range that finishes today shows today's relations, interactions and meetings instead of stopping at midnight.
tr: Analiz tarih aralıkları artık bittiği günü de kapsıyor. Bugünle biten bir aralık seçtiğinde bugünün eşleştirmeleri, etkileşimleri ve görüşmeleri de görünüyor — gece yarısında kesilmiyor.
de: Analyse-Zeiträume schließen jetzt den Tag ein, an dem sie enden. Ein Zeitraum bis heute zeigt auch die heutigen Mentorenbeziehungen, Interaktionen und Termine, statt um Mitternacht abzuschneiden.
